Short title and commencement

SINDH DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend certain
laws relating to development authorities in force in certain areas of the
Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 18th March, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(6)/97, dated 18‑3‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Development Authorities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Act No.V of 1994 and Act No.VII of 1995

Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 18th March, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(6)/97, dated 18‑3‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Sindh Act No.V of 1994 and Act No.VII of 1995.‑‑In the Sehwan
Development Authority Act, 1993 and the Badin Development Authority Act, 1995,
in section 4, in subsection (1), for clauses (a) and (b), the following shall
be substituted and the remaining clauses be renumbered accordingly:‑‑
"(a) Commissioner of the
Hyderabad
Division Chairman. "
